moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: This booster loss does not change our timeline to reach high volume, fully reusable Starship flights.
moments.why: Musk’s reassurance after SpaceX’s Flight 15 sees Starship’s booster fail a midair catch but upper stage caught—spinning a setback into a bullish milestone.
moments.url: CBS News coverage of Starship catch and Musk quote

moments.author: SpaceX commentary (quoted)
moments.quote: "We caught a Starship, and now everything changes."
moments.why: That line captures the jaw‑dropping scale of the first ever mid‑air Starship upper‑stage catch, dominating conversation.
moments.url: CBS News coverage quoting SpaceX commentator Jessie Anderson

moments.author: Philadelphia Eagles GM Howie Roseman (quoted)
moments.why: Roseman’s pre‑game quip urging bringing Miami QB Darian Mensah to Philly sparked a firestorm in Eagles X threads.
